hooks.command: input=$(cat); printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '(^|/)(tests/.+\.py|web/src/.+\.test\.tsx?|web/e2e/.+\.ts)$' || exit 0; printf '%s' "$input" | uv run --no-sync --quiet --project "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" python "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/guard_test_edits.py 2>/dev/null || exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | xargs -I{} uv run ruff check {} --fix --quiet --ignore F401 2>/dev/null; exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -E '\.(tsx?|jsx?)$' | xargs -I{} pnpm --prefix web exec biome check --write {} 2>/dev/null; exit 0
